# Align Neo.core.Config#initDescriptor JSDoc with Config.prototype

## Context

Surfaced during review of `#21014` (implementing `#21010` under Epic `#20498` / responsibility map `#20527`) per `.agents/skills/pr-review/references/pr-review-guide.md` §2.5 (*"Verified inherited debt beyond a safe repair gets a real issue in this review, whatever the verdict"*). When authoring the new Config Descriptors reference section against `src/core/Config.mjs`, `#21014` transcribed two stale `@param` defaults from `Neo.core.Config#initDescriptor` (`lines 90–97`) that contradict `Config.prototype` and runtime behavior.

Ownership: `unowned-rationale: Ready for a contributor; maintainers provide planning and review.`

## The Problem

In `src/core/Config.mjs`, the `@member` JSDoc blocks (`lines 40–63`) and `Object.defineProperties(Config.prototype, ...)` (`lines 237–242`) were updated when prototype-level defaults (`cloneOnGet: null`, `mergeStrategy: 'replace'`) replaced earlier descriptor defaults (`#6934`), but `initDescriptor`'s method JSDoc (`lines 89–98`) was never updated to match:

1. **`descriptor.cloneOnGet` (`line 94`):** Currently reads:
   `@param {string} [descriptor.cloneOnGet] - The clone strategy for get. Defaults to 'shallow' if clone is 'deep' or 'shallow', and 'none' if clone is 'none'.`
   At runtime, `Config.prototype.cloneOnGet` is `null` (`lines 49, 239`) and `initDescriptor` (`lines 108–112`) never derives `cloneOnGet` from `clone`. In the generated getter (`src/Neo.mjs:387–409`), `Date` values are always cloned (`new Date(value.valueOf())`); when `cloneOnGet` is explicitly set (`'deep'`, `'shallow'`, or `'none'`), that strategy governs (`'none'` skips the fallback array copy); when `cloneOnGet` remains `null`, `Array` values are shallow-sliced (`value.slice()`) regardless of `clone` while plain objects are returned without copying.
2. **`descriptor.merge` (`line 96`):** Currently reads:
   `@param {string} [descriptor.merge='deep'] - The merge strategy.`
   At runtime, `Config.prototype.mergeStrategy` defaults to `'replace'` (`lines 60, 62, 241`), NOT `'deep'`, and `descriptor.merge` accepts `{Function|String}` (`'replace'`, `'shallow'`, `'deep'`, `'deepArrays'`, or a custom `(defaultValue, instanceValue) => merged` function in `Neo.mergeConfig`, `src/Neo.mjs:713–738`).
3. **Summary key list (`line 90`) & class header wording (`line 10`):**
   - `line 90` says `Extracts clone, mergeStrategy and isEqual from the descriptor`, omitting `cloneOnGet` and naming the target field `mergeStrategy` instead of the input descriptor key `merge` (`initDescriptor({clone, cloneOnGet, isEqual, merge})`).
   - `line 10` refers to `"the Neo.mjs framework"` instead of `"the Neo.mjs runtime engine"` (category-drift terminology).

## The Architectural Reality

- `Design authority:` `src/core/Config.mjs` `@member` JSDoc (`lines 46–63`) and `Config.prototype` (`lines 237–242`): *"The cloning strategy to use when getting a value. Supported values: 'deep', 'shallow', 'none'. `@member {String} cloneOnGet=null`"* and *"Defaults to 'replace'. Can be overridden via a descriptor merge property. Supported values: 'deep', 'deepArrays', 'replace', 'shallow'. `@member {Function|String} mergeStrategy='replace'`"*.
- `src/core/Config.mjs:99–125`: `initDescriptor({clone, cloneOnGet, isEqual, merge})` defines own properties on `me` only when truthy and differing from `Config.prototype` (`clone`, `cloneOnGet`, `isEqual`, and `merge` → `me.mergeStrategy`).
- `src/Neo.mjs:387–409`: generated reactive getter checks `value instanceof Date`, then `else if (config.cloneOnGet)` (`'deep'` / `'shallow'`, with `'none'` truthy so it bypasses the legacy branch), then `else if (Array.isArray(value)) { value = value.slice() }`.
- `src/Neo.mjs:713–738, 1029–1033` & `src/core/Base.mjs:767–773`: `Neo.mergeConfig(defaultValue, instanceValue, strategy)` supports `'shallow'`, `'deep'`, `'deepArrays'`, custom `Function`, and falls back to `'replace'` (`return instanceValue`).

Decision Record impact: `none`.

## The Fix

Update JSDoc comments only in `src/core/Config.mjs` (zero runtime behavior change):

1. **`line 10`:** Replace `within the Neo.mjs framework.` with `within the Neo.mjs runtime engine.`
2. **`line 90`:** Update the summary sentence to accurately name the extracted descriptor keys (`clone`, `cloneOnGet`, `isEqual`, and `merge`, storing `merge` on `mergeStrategy`).
3. **`lines 93–97`:** Align `@param` types (`{String}` / `{Function|String}` matching the `@member` tags above) and defaults:
   - `[descriptor.clone='deep']` — supported values `'deep'`, `'shallow'`, `'none'`.
   - `[descriptor.cloneOnGet=null]` — supported values `'deep'`, `'shallow'`, `'none'`; when `null` (unset), `Date` values are cloned and `Array` values are shallow-sliced on read while plain objects return as-is (`src/Neo.mjs` getter).
   - `[descriptor.isEqual=Neo.isEqual]` — equality comparison function.
   - `[descriptor.merge='replace']` — `{Function|String}` merge strategy (`'replace'`, `'shallow'`, `'deep'`, `'deepArrays'`, or a `(defaultValue, instanceValue)` function).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1:** `src/core/Config.mjs` `initDescriptor` JSDoc (`lines 89–98`) lists the exact descriptor keys (`clone`, `cloneOnGet`, `isEqual`, `merge`, `value`) and accurate defaults (`clone='deep'`, `cloneOnGet=null`, `isEqual=Neo.isEqual`, `merge='replace'`) with `{Function|String}` on `descriptor.merge`, matching `Config.prototype` (`lines 237–242`) and `src/Neo.mjs`.
- [ ] **AC-2:** `src/core/Config.mjs` class JSDoc (`line 10`) replaces `Neo.mjs framework` with `Neo.mjs runtime engine`.
- [ ] **AC-3:** Zero runtime lines in `src/core/Config.mjs` change, and existing Config unit tests (`npx playwright test test/playwright/unit/config/ --config=test/playwright/playwright.config.unit.mjs`) pass.

## Out of Scope

- Changing runtime `cloneOnGet`, `clone`, or `mergeStrategy` behavior in `src/core/Config.mjs`, `src/Neo.mjs`, or `src/core/Base.mjs`.
- Guide edits in `learn/guides/fundamentals/ConfigSystemDeepDive.md` (owned by `#21010` / PR `#21014`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Changing `Config.prototype` defaults to match the stale JSDoc:** `cloneOnGet: null` and `mergeStrategy: 'replace'` are load-bearing across the engine (changing default `mergeStrategy` to `'deep'` or cloning every plain object on get would break reference identity and regress hot getters). Only the stale JSDoc in `src/core/Config.mjs` changes.
